rag.name: Matroid.loop_iff_circuit
rag.content:
/-- An element is a loop iff its singleton set is a circuit. -/
lemma Matroid.loop_iff_circuit (M : Matroid α) {a : α} :
    M.Loop a ↔ M.Circuit {a} :=
  ⟨
    fun ha => ⟨
      ha.right,
      fun _ hM hMa => (Set.subset_singleton_iff_eq.→ hMa).casesOn
        (· ▸ hM |>.not_indep M.empty_indep |>.elim)
        (·.symm.subset)
      ⟩,
    fun ha => ⟨ha.left.right rfl, ha.dep⟩
  ⟩

rag.name: Matroid.coloop_iff_in_no_circuit
rag.content:
/-- An element is a coloop iff it belongs to no circuit. -/
lemma Matroid.coloop_iff_in_no_circuit (M : Matroid α) {a : α} :
    M.Coloop a ↔ a ∈ M.E ∧ ∀ C : Set α, M.Circuit C → a ∉ C := by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨haE, M_dual_Dep_a⟩
    refine ⟨haE, fun C hC haC => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hCaB⟩ := (hC.indep_diff_singleton haC).exists_isBase_superset
    have haB := (Matroid.dual_dep_iff_forall.→ M_dual_Dep_a).left B hB
    have hMB : M.Dep B
    · rw [Matroid.dep_iff_has_circuit]
      have hCB := Set.diff_union_of_subset (Set.singleton_subset_iff.← haC) ▸ Set.union_subset hCaB
        (Set.singleton_subset_iff.← (Set.singleton_inter_nonempty.→ haB))
      exact ⟨M.subset_ground B hB, C, hC, hCB⟩
    exact hMB.not_indep hB.indep
  · intro ⟨haE, haC⟩
    constructor
    · exact haE
    · rw [Matroid.dual_dep_iff_forall]
      constructor
      · intro B hB
        by_contra! haB
        obtain ⟨C', hC', hC'aB, haC'⟩ := hB.indep.circuit_of_insert_dep
          (hB.dep_of_insert (Set.singleton_inter_eq_empty.→ haB) haE)
        exact haC C' hC' haC'
      · rwa [Set.singleton_subset_iff]

theorem univ_eq_singleton_of_card_one {α} [Fintype α] (x : α) (h : Fintype.card α = 1) :
    (univ : Finset α) = {x} := by
  symm
  apply eq_of_subset_of_card_le (subset_univ {x})
  apply le_of_eq
  simp [h, Finset.card_univ]

informal_statement: In a matroid, a singleton element is a separator if and only if it is a loop or a coloop.

id.name: Matroid.singleton_separator_iff
id.content:
/-- Singleton element is a separator iff it is a loop or a coloop -/
lemma Matroid.singleton_separator_iff {M : Matroid α} (x : α) :
    x ∈ M.E ∧ M.Separator {x} ↔ M.Loop x ∨ M.Coloop x := by
  constructor
  · intro hxE
    exact M.singleton_separator_loop_coloop hxE.left hxE.right
  · intro hxx
    cases hxx with
    | inl xLoop => exact ⟨xLoop.left, Matroid.separator_loop xLoop⟩
    | inr xColoop => exact ⟨xColoop.left, Matroid.separator_coloop xColoop⟩
